text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Suzuka, Fukukitaru! What kinda
birthday
presents did ya get me?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't think you're supposed to ask
about your
own presents... but I did get
you one.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And I... got you a present multiplying
charm!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
A multiplying charm? What's that?
Anyway, Taiki,
here's your present...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hrngh, and now for the multiplying
effect!
Multiple dupitle, give me an
armful! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Taiki, we've been answered! Today, you
have
special permission to hug Suzuka as
much as you
like!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Suzuka, you don't mind? My
birthday
present just got multiplied!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what? That's... Well, okay. Just a
bit, then...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's right. Can I use my
runny-run charm,
then?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Taiki, however much you hug me, you
get to hug
Fukukitaru three times as
much afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat? That's no fair, Suzuka!
Hnnghh, in that
case...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's all three of us have a big hug
festival! ♪
Praise be, praise be! Wahoo!
Hawoo!
